object_scope_note: Issuer-reported OPERATIONAL observation about OCP's own sulfur consumption. Narrow directional statement only; NOT a tonnage, percentage, causal-elasticity, or national-consumption claim.
claim_scope: OCP Group's FY2024 consolidated financial report (MD&A narrative on purchases consumed, page 21) reports that OCP's sulfur consumption volumes increased in correlation with the rise in sulfuric-acid production during FY2024. Issuer-reported, OCP-own-operations, FY2024-scoped. Establishes ONLY the directional increase-in-correlation observation.

locator.system: OCP Group — Consolidated Financial Statements at 31 December 2024 (IFRS), original uploaded PDF
locator.section: Management narrative on 'Purchases of raw materials' / purchases consumed
locator.verbatim_statement: However, sulfur consumption volumes increased in correlation with the rise in sulfuric acid production.

qualitative.supported_proposition: OCP reports that its sulfur consumption volumes increased in correlation with the rise in sulfuric-acid production during FY2024.
not_inferred: that all sulfur purchased was consumed in the period

quarantined_not_admitted.what: The same paragraph's sulfur PRICE statement.
quarantined_not_admitted.printed_text: Sulfur purchases decreased by 256 million dirhams due to the drop in price per ton ($127/T CFR in FY2024 compared to $113/T CFR in FY2023).
quarantined_not_admitted.internal_inconsistency: The prose says 'drop in price per ton', but the printed figures rise (FY2024 127 > FY2023 113); and it says purchases 'decreased by 256' while the Note 4.2.2 magnitude rises from 8,088 to 8,344 (a +256 change in magnitude). Direction of prose vs printed numbers is inconsistent.
quarantined_not_admitted.handling: EXCLUDED from admitted Pilot-02 evidence/claims. Not silently fixed, years not reversed, no external knowledge used to resolve it, and NOT used to explain the Claim-A accounting movement. Promotion to admitted evidence requires an explicit, separate resolution step that does not exist in this sprint.
